arxiv-2409-11989.description: Abstract . This paper presents the Equimetrics data capture system. pmc-10562707.title: Metabolomic analyses provide insights into the preharvest rind disorder in Satsuma Owari Mandarin
pmc-10562707.creator: Tariq Pervaiz, Suejin Park, Alaaeldin Rezk, Manhoi Hur, David Obenland, Mary Lu Arpaia, Ashraf El-kereamy
pmc-10562707.description: Citrus fruit’s appearance is the primary criterion used to assess its quality for the fresh market, hence the rind’s condition is a crucial quality trait. Pre-harvest rind disorder is one of the major physiological problems in mandarins. The disorder occurs right before harvest following rain events in some Mandarin varieties.

pmc-10694673.title: RAGE engagement by SARS-CoV-2 enables monocyte infection and underlies COVID-19 severity
pmc-10694673.creator: Roberta Angioni, Matteo Bonfanti, Nicolò Caporale, Ricardo Sánchez-Rodríguez, Fabio Munari, Aurora Savino, Sebastiano Pasqualato, Damiano Buratto, Isabel Pagani, Nicole Bertoldi, Carlo Zanon, Paolo Ferrari, Eugenia Ricciardelli, Cristina Putaggio, Silvia Ghezzi, Francesco Elli, Luca Rotta, Alessandr
pmc-10694673.description: SummaryThe spread of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) has fueled the COVID-19 pandemic with its enduring medical and socioeconomic challenges because of subsequent waves and long-term consequences of great concern. Here, we chart the molecular basis of COVID-19 pathogenesis by analyzing patients’ immune responses at single-cell resolution across disease course and severity.

pmc-11349202.title: Estimating orientation in natural scenes: A spiking neural network model of the insect central complex
pmc-11349202.creator: Rachael Stentiford, James C. Knight, Thomas Nowotny, Andrew Philippides, Paul Graham, Hugues Berry, Thomas Serre, Hugues Berry, Hugues Berry
pmc-11349202.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The central complex of insects contains cells, organised as a ring attractor, that encode head direction. The ‘bump’ of activity in the ring can be updated by idiothetic cues and external sensory information.

pmc-11437325.title: A survey of the participants’ learning outcomes after finishing the dental radiology course for the continuing education of medical radiation technologists in Taiwan
pmc-11437325.creator: Feng-Chou Cheng, Mu-Hsiung Chen, Yu-Wen Wang, Chun-Hung Chen, Kun-Lung Pin, Chien-Yi Ting, Chun-Pin Chiang
pmc-11437325.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background/purposeIn Taiwan, there are very few dental radiology curricula in medical radiation education system. This study assessed the participants’ learning outcomes after finishing the dental radiology course for the continuing education of medical radiation technologists in Taiwan.Materials and methodsThis study used the questionnaire survey to evaluate the participants’ learning outcomes after finishing the dental radiology course for the continuing education of medical radiation technologists in Taiwan.ResultsIn this study, 85 participants filled out the questionnaires completely after finishing the dental radiology course.

pmc-11587031.title: Impact of Four Weeks of TOGU Training on Neuromuscular Control and Golf Swing Performance
pmc-11587031.creator: Mohan Li, Caixian Ruan, Lin Zhang, Giuseppe Musumeci
pmc-11587031.description: Purpose: To assess the impact of a four-week training program combining TOGU (a functional training system and equipment) Balanza and Dynair® Ballkissen equipment on core strength, balance ability, and golf swing performance in golf athletes. Methods: The TOGU group participated in TOGU training three times weekly and regular golf skill training over four weeks.

pmc-12748408.title: Histomolecular Features of a Rare Subtype of Pleomorphic Adenoma Characterised by Abundant Lymphoid Stroma and HMGA2 Rearrangements
pmc-12748408.creator: Ziyad Alsugair, Seddig Momenkhan, Marie Donzel, Françoise Descotes, Daniel Pissaloux, Sandrine Paindavoine, Aurelie Houlier, Franck Tirode, Eudeline Alix, Claire Mauduit, Jonathan Lopez, Alexandra Traverse-Glehen, Philippe Céruse, Pierre Philouze, Anne Champagnac, Valérie Costes-Martineau, Yoshinao
pmc-12748408.description: AimsTo describe the morphological features and explore the molecular profiles of pleomorphic adenomas (PA) with abundant lymphoid stroma and HMGA2 rearrangements, and to compare them with classic lymphadenomas, in order to identify a potential molecular and morphological overlap.MethodsFour cases of PA with abundant lymphoid stroma and HMGA2 rearrangements were identified from four different institutions in France and Japan.

pmc-12751859.title: Prices, availability, and affordability of selected medicines for asthma management in Nigeria: a nationwide study
pmc-12751859.creator: Kosisochi Chinwendu Amorha, Faith Nnenna Eze, Ifeoma Felicita Uzuh, Somtochi Prosper Nwani, Jennifer Chigozie Iganga, Chidera Edith Eze, Chukwudi Richard Ifeanyi, Adaora Anthonia Agubata, Chisom Sandra Ibenekwu, Immaculata Chidimma Aniebonam, Angela Chinasa Ani, Chinelo Cynthia Ezenwafor, Emelda Chi
pmc-12751859.description: BackgroundRecent inflation in Nigeria could hinder access to medicines. The aim of the study was to evaluate the prices, availability, and affordability of selected medicines for asthma management in Nigeria.MethodsThis cross-sectional survey (January 2024 – March 2024) was conducted in community pharmacies in the six geopolitical zones of Nigeria.

pmc-13039369.title: Optimization of infectious disease intervention measures using reinforcement learning with UK COVID-19 epidemic data
pmc-13039369.creator: Baida Zhang, Yakai Chen, Huichun Li, Zhenghu Zu
pmc-13039369.description: Globally, the outbreaks of infectious diseases have exerted an extremely profound and severe influence on health security and the economy. During the critical phases of epidemics, devising effective intervention measures poses a significant challenge to both the academic and practical arenas. There is numerous research based on reinforcement learning to optimize intervention measures of infectious diseases.

pmc-13101260.title: The predictive effect of Kellgren-Lawrence grade and joint space height on pain and functional outcome
pmc-13101260.creator: Anni Rajamäki, Lari Lehtovirta, Aleksi Reito, Mika Niemeläinen, Antti Eskelinen
pmc-13101260.description: BackgroundPlain radiographs play a key role in the diagnosis of knee osteoarthritis (OA), with the Kellgren-Lawrence (KL) grading system being widely used to assess radiographic severity of the disease. Previous studies have suggested that radiographically less severe knee OA may be associated with inferior outcomes following total knee replacement (TKA).

pmc-13662464.title: Dosimetric comparison of organs at risk exposure in multicatheter high-dose-rate interstitial brachytherapy vs. VMAT-based APBI for real patient treatment plans
pmc-13662464.creator: Agnieszka Krzystyniak, Rafał Maksim, Kamil Szczecina, Karol Motybel, Viktoryia Petrasheuskaya, Anna Szmigiel-Trzcin´ska, Anna Kozłowska, Tomasz Filipowski, Dorota Kazberuk
pmc-13662464.description: PurposeTo dosimetrically compare multicatheter interstitial high-dose-rate brachytherapy (MIBT) with two volumetric modulated arc therapy (VMAT) techniques, i.e., continuous (cVMAT) and tangential (tVMAT), for accelerated partial breast irradiation (APBI), specifically focusing on organs at risk (OARs) exposure.Material and methodsTreatment plans of 50 early-stage breast cancer patients treated with interstitial multicatheter HDR brachytherapy (MIBT) were analyzed.

pmc-13677127.title: Influence of Polishing Treatment on the Topography of 3D‐Printed Provisional Resins: An In Vitro Study
pmc-13677127.creator: Yousif A Al-Dulaijan, Abdulrahman Mohammad Aldossari, Abdulrahman Salem Bin-jabair, Hamed S Alghamdi, Hanan Al-Johani, Abdulrahman A Balhaddad, Murilo Baena Lopes
pmc-13677127.description: Although 3D‐printing has been increasingly integrated in the fabrication of provisional restorations, the evidence regarding the impact of different polishing regimens on their topographical features is unclear. This in vitro study assessed the outcomes of different polishing treatments on roughness measurements of 3D‐printed provisional resin materials compared to that of a conventional polymethyl methacrylate (PMMA).
